summary: The Cinch-built compiler emits all 43 compiler interfaces and the repaired compiler checks its real entry using those APIs. It also compiles and runs Cinch’s own test runner with exact reports and zero leaks. Fresh stage-chain and full-suite verification remain.
activity: The complete private-layout validation passed. The fresh pinned Stage0 build and all three smokes pass; Stage1 is building. The final 208-group suite is compiling on the exact same frozen source and will use three shared workers. The earlier sweep is draining without launching more old-source tests.

checks.title: Actual self-built compiler consumes the compiler APIs
checks.detail: The repaired Cinch compiler emits and links successfully and checks its real entry with implementation bodies absent. The reduced public-return case passes, while private constructor import, private type annotation and a wrong field carrier are all refused.

checks.title: Cinch compiles and runs its own test runner
checks.detail: Both programs compile through the actual self-built compiler and produce exact reports: two deliberate failures are correctly counted, and the passing suite reports zero. Both run with a 32M heap and report zero leaks. A separate checked test-library bundle supplies the requested list-length variant.

checks.title: Complete private-layout regression passed
checks.detail: Validation9 passes source checking, the expanded writer/privacy case, type export, nominal identity, parsing and region contracts. Kind facts are retained from actual public constructor contracts; source names and private constructors remain hidden.

checks.title: All 43 compiler interfaces pass independent readback
checks.detail: Actual self-built compiler validation2 emits all 43 documents. Native parses and canonically roundtrips them and verifies the chain and coherence across 98 total modules; every source hash matches its full module slice. The reserved Main.main identity repair passes the separate complete writer7 regression.

checks.title: Full baseline finished: 201 of 205 groups passed
checks.detail: Candidate23 finished with four failing groups: parser coverage, failed-output handling, lattice transfers and refinements. The original failures remain recorded. Fresh complete parser and pipeline reruns now pass; final-source verification is still required.

checks.title: Final-source verification and repairs
checks.detail: Candidate25 uses the same frozen source as the fresh full stage chain. Its 207 test runners are compiling, with 208 groups including documentation. The previous candidate24 sweep is draining after the validated private-layout source change; its historical passes are not relabeled as final coverage.

checks.title: Checked interfaces run through the self-built compiler
checks.detail: The self-built Stage3 compiles and executes the advanced writer. Independent Native readers accept its schema, canonical form and dependency hashes; public aliases work and private constructors and importer fixity overrides are refused.

checks.title: Updated interface writer passes its complete focused gates
checks.detail: Validation7 passes the full interface, type-export, parser, 16 effect tests and region-contract checks. It verifies Main.main, public operation contracts, definition-owned fixities and private constructor boundaries. The new private-layout regression is being tested separately.

checks.title: Compiler interface CLI and complete source identities verified
checks.detail: The CLI emits checked interface files and refuses invalid input. The seed builds all 43 compiler modules. Source hashes now cover each complete module body rather than only its header.

checks.title: Parser and failed-output regressions repaired
checks.detail: The full corrected parser target and full corrected pipeline target pass on fresh snapshots. Coverage includes all 109 measured parser entries and four stale-output refusal probes.

checks.title: 36 tooling checks passed
checks.detail: The staged-build driver checks pass with the new interface-producing compiler mode. The final combined stage/interface fixed point remains open.

checks.title: Rust linear-parameter ownership repaired
checks.detail: A linear parameter used once in its own lambda body was incorrectly rejected. The independent reproduction now passes; all23 ownership tests pass, including refusal of capture, duplicate use and dropped parameters.

checks.title: Self-built compiler rebuilds changed source correctly
checks.detail: Stage2 compiles a modified compiler; that executable produces the changed diagnostic label and correctly refuses the invalid probe. The verification driver now explicitly uses Stage2 for this gate.

checks.title: Stage2 and Stage3 compiler code matches exactly
checks.detail: Candidate23: identical LLVM IR and executable SHA256; Stage3 also passes valid-program, precedence and invalid-source smoke checks. This does not establish the compiler-interface fixed point.

checks.title: 100 programs executed
checks.detail: 82 runtime cases on candidate 10 and 18 linked-object cases on candidate 14. The linked cases, including the direct intrinsic export, all report zero leaks; the whole object target passed.

checks.title: All five builder checks passed
checks.detail: Candidate 20 passes exact text, string-concatenation oracle, chunk counts, scale, and 65,536 newline chunks on a 2 MiB stack.

checks.title: Direct proof reuse and complete builder checks pass
checks.detail: Candidate23 passes the entire proof certificate regression. Its fresh Stage1 accepts the reduced outer-guard case and complete builder, while refusing an out-of-bounds write.

blockers.title: Finish the fresh combined compiler/interface fixed point
blockers.detail: The real entry consumer now passes and the private-layout repair is verified. The fresh pinned chain must build Stage1, Stage2 and Stage3, then compare compiler code and canonical interfaces and verify changed-source behavior. Stage0 and its three smokes already pass.
blockers.technical: Frozen source 6c6644d69b3b32aa04992f6793de634278c07fe717bce59d1d0dc05d24cd3b69; compiler source 3bebaa8120734fda92b0cde338debabdb160a9ebd58bf1f22c2a0c3fe96cfe63. No Native fallback for compiler implementation code after Stage1.

blockers.title: Finish all tests on the final source
blockers.detail: The final complete sweep and stage chain share one immutable source snapshot. Three bounded suite workers will run after test compilation; runtime, tooling and syntax verification are also queued. The earlier baseline failures all have passing repair checks.
blockers.technical: All 713 execution inputs checked against the published tree match this snapshot. Later progress/evidence/prose updates are excluded from that code audit. Three shared test slots plus the stage probe and the separate syntax worker stay within the five-heavy-job limit.
